_doc: Hand-set verdicts for tools/rules_audit.py (v0.55.1). Each entry: match = case-insensitive substring of the item text (coverage row, glossary id or rule-note line); verdict = confirmed | house | conflict | open; source = section/page/URL; note = what to do. Entries win over the automatic classification. Sources: docs/manual-notes.md 'Sources and versions'.

items.note: The rule makes the Soul Core part of every game (setup: 3 cores + 1 Soul Core in the Reserve); it does not force spending it. Engine setup already does this. Soul-Core-moving costs (e.g. [Kidou]) may use up the source Spirit; a later 'when you've done so' / 'after Burst' part then fails. Coverage row status was stale.

R3: a leaving Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus waits in Standby, resolves its leave triggers (When Destroyed, When Banished, when it leaves the Field), then goes to the Trash or its destination; its symbols still reduce costs and applied effects persist meanwhile. v0.57.0: built as p.standby (06-rules.js removeSpirit / releaseStandby): a destroyed or depleted card waits there while its queued (When Destroyed) / ally-lost effects resolve, its symbols still reduce costs, cores already in the Reserve; then Trash or its destination. Leaves with no leave trigger (banish, bounce, Nexus) go to the destination at once, which the rule makes equivalent; When Banished / when it leaves the Field triggers do not exist in the engine yet. Test S557.

items.source: JP 17.0 revision notice item 4; Eternal manual p. 31
items.note: Same as Standby: (When Destroyed) resolves while the card waits in Standby, not after it is in the Trash. Built in v0.57.0 (fxValid accepts a DESTROYED source in p.standby; test S557-01).

Built in v0.58.0: 'cannot' wins over 'must' (Spirits that can't block are removed before a MUST_BLOCK attacker forces a block; a Spirit unaffected by the attacker is not bound, 08-battle.js); 'cannot be prevented' (action ignoreImmune) > 'unaffected' (STATIC UNAFFECTED / HAND_UNAFFECTED, fxImmune with the acting source) per FAQ Q3. 'do' and 'can' have no ordering in the engine (none needed). Tests A58-10/11.
Glossary note now cites the 17.0 order cannot > must > do = can (v0.58.0).

items.match: Constant effects not negatable by "cannot be prevented" (17.0)
items.note: Official: constant effects with no place or condition (granting a family or symbol) are not stopped by 'effects can't activate'. Engine still has no 'effects can't activate' action (v0.58.0 built 'unaffected', not 'can't activate'), so nothing conflicts; build both together when the first card needs it.

Declaring at the event is right (one at a time; not declared = lost for that event). But a declared Burst resolves AFTER all non-Burst triggered effects of the event, several Bursts in declaration order (non-turn player first). Fixed in v0.55.2: flushBursts() runs every queued non-Burst event first, then the Bursts (non-turn player first); tests B552-01..04.

items.source: JP 17.0 revision notice item 6 (Bursts resolve last, declaration order)
items.note: Cross-player ordering of triggered effects still partial; Burst ordering fixed in v0.55.2 (K_BURST).
